note: The LICENSE-RESTRICTED tier is never exported. Only its metadata-only public projection (source IRI + title + year + licence status; no abstract-derived text) is included. This repo is PRIVATE until the maintainer reviews the tier-enforcement guarantees and explicitly flips visibility.

tier_semantics.hand-authored: Human-curated PKG data: task projections from bd + skill front-matter + hand-authored AGENTS.md findings (ingest_pkg.py output).
tier_semantics.machine: Literature pipeline output for sources with a known redistributable licence (CC-BY, CC0, public-domain). Machine-tier findings are capped at confidence ≤ 0.7 and assurance ≤ Conjectured.
tier_semantics.restricted-projection: Metadata-only public view of the license-restricted tier: source IRI, title, year, and licence status only. No abstract-derived text.
